messages:
sara_cs: Quick sync: GlowHealth just confirmed two additional squads (personalization, insights) want to start production traffic in ~4 weeks. Theyre asking about options for predictable latency and cost.
omar_se: Do we have projected QPS/token volumes?
sara_cs: They estimate 120 embedding reqs/s (batched) + 40 chat r/s peak, avg tokens/request ~280. Ramp over 3-5 weeks.
jules_re: Renewal is in 88 days. We should treat this as an expansion+renewal opportunity.
tom_support: Ran a small sim on shared fleet. Token cost ok but cold-start KV misses spike error rate. Might impact 95th pct latency.
kai_infra: Suggest reserving a 2-GPU dedicated pool and enabling prefix/KV caching with pre-warm. I can open reservation ticket.
kai_infra: Created infra ticket infra-4620 to reserve 2xA100 for GlowHealth pilot (ETA 48 hrs).
omar_se: I'll put together a Dedicated pilot proposal: committed throughput tier, canary for 30 days, overage pricing, and expected per-token savings.
sara_cs: Customer asked for enablement: 2 x 60min sessions (embed tuning + ops). Wed/Fri next week preferred.
tom_support: I'll prepare a monitoring runbook and a dashboard snapshot. Link to draft: https://console.redwood/teams/glowhealth/ops-board
omar_se: Quick cost calc snippet for proposal:
``
# rough monthly tokens estimate
qps=120
tokens_per_req=280
monthly_tokens=qps*tokens_per_req*3600*24*30
```
use that to compare committed vs hosted PAYG.
jules_re: Also capture renewal play: propose multi-quarter commit discount if they commit now. Flag if onboarding slips >2 weeks as higher churn risk.
sara_cs: Action items: kai -> infra-4620 (in progress), omar -> proposal draft EOD, tom -> dashboard + workshop slides, sara -> coordinate dates & renewal watch.
deploy-bot: infra-4620 state changed: provisioning scheduled (2xA100)
sara_cs: Please log pilot feedback metrics well track: embed quality (recall@k), median/95 latency, error rates by model variant, and cost delta.
omar_se: I'll include an ops SLA for canary and checklist for model variants to try (quantized vs fp16).
sara_cs: Great. I'll update the customer health record after the proposal and mark as expansion-opportunity. :thumbsup:
